title: mview document tabs
brief: Reuse one Workbench browser page for files opened from the terminal, with a visible active document and responsive, keyboard-accessible navigation. Tabs live until the viewer exits. The Edit demo shows isolated drafts; the existing document toolbar and review flow remain separate.

artboards.title: Toolbar tabs
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps the current height on wide screens; the tab strip shares space with Edit, Render as and Theme.

artboards.title: Document strip
artboards.tradeoff: Shows more complete filenames and leaves controls in place; costs one slim row.

artboards.title: Workbench rail
artboards.tradeoff: Scales to a longer list on desktop; documents and the current outline share the side pane.
